newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-ALL ENGLAND FIRST ROUND RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-ALL ENGLAND FIRST ROUND RESULTS.

text.p: First round results in the All England badminton championships on Tuesday (prefix number denotes seeding):
Martin Lundgaard Hansen (Denmark) beat Robert Nock (England) 15-5 15-13
Yong Hock Kin (Malaysia) beat Dicky Palyama (Netherlands) 15-6 15-5
Choi Ma-rae (South Korea) beat Pernille Harder (Denmark) 11-3 11-4
Park Jin-hyun (South Korea) beat Anne Gibson (Scotland) 11-1 11-9

Add men's singles: 1-Poul-Erik Hoyer-Larsen (Denmark) beat Gerben Bruystens (Netherlands) 15-8 15-2 9/16 Dong Jiong (China) beat Ardy Wiranata (Indonesia) 15-9 18-15 Jesper Olsson (Sweden) beat Shinji Ohta (Japan) 15-7 15-4 Luo Yigang (China) beat 5/8 Thomas Stuer-Lauridsen (Denmark) 15-11 15-11 Mark Constable (England) beat Mikhail Korshouk (Belarus) 15-5 15-4 Peter Knowles (England) beat Peter Janum (Denmark) 5-15 15-6 15-5

Add women's singles: Mette Sorensen (Denmark) beat Gillian Martin (Scotland) 11-6 11-1 Ra Kyung-min (South Korea) beat Brenda Beenhakker (Netherlands) 11-9 11-1 Lee Joo-hyun (South Korea) beat Mette Pedersen (Denmark) 11-9 11-3 Marina Andrievskaya (Sweden) beat Lotte Thomsen (Denmark) 11-4 11-2 Michelle Rasmussen (Denmark) beat Katarzyna Krasowska (Poland) 12-10 4-11 11-8 Han Jingna (China) beat Yuliani Santoso (Indonesia) 11-4 11-0
